product_problem: Derive durable site consequences from typed local actions instead of caller terminal claims, then materialize the same immutable blueprint without respawning depleted or neutralized content.

hostile_arms: idle, wrong, mixed, and self-rehashed active checkpoints fail admission
teleport, diagonal, zero-step, remote targets, unknown actions, and caller terminal claims fail closed
stale journal checkpoints and dropped, reordered, duplicated, mixed, or self-rehashed event chains fail replay
threat ticks follow an independent lexical-ID oracle and lethal effects conserve actual applied damage
terminal settlement binds the full journal and exact RP-0004 enter, idle, and journey checkpoints
JSON and Variant mid-visit continuation normalize integral numbers and reject non-finite, fractional, string, and huge values
second visits inherit scars and cannot target depleted loot or neutralized threats
the 512th ordinary action produces reducer-owned exhaustion collapse instead of an unresolvable active state

regressions.runtime_dependency_scan: SiteVisitJournalModel preloads only SiteBlueprintModel and ScaleAddress; ScarredRevisitLab preloads only resource-pool models; no Sim, Main, WorldView, SpaceGraph, or production-to-lab runtime reference

visual_gate.review: no P0, P1, or P2; fresh promise, typed prefix, collapse scars, destroyed-blocker route, depletion revisit, and zero-scar abort are readable

promotion_requires: persist the RP-0004 active checkpoint, journal start, full ordered events, and owner-held latest journal receipt
atomically accept each journal sequence once and reject sibling receipts at that sequence
validate the original RP-0004 enter transition and independent idle and journey checkpoints
commit active-to-idle site scars and once-only expedition or cargo settlement in one owner transaction
inject authored stable IDs into receiver-owned local entities rather than infer identity from label, position, or count
add untrusted-input size limits, a production save-schema migration, and compiler/content/rules revision migration
deferred_to_rp0006: aggregated settlement aid, trade, and fortification choices
